title: Android SDK Build-Tools install fails with Connection reset
signature: connection reset while preparing sdk package android sdk build tools|Network

failed_jobs.name: CXX_Unit_Tests
failed_jobs.symptom: Android SDK Build-Tools 36 install fails with Connection reset; emulator never starts, ADB port 5554 refused

key_errors: Warning: An error occurred while preparing SDK package Android SDK Build-Tools 36: Connection reset.
error: could not connect to TCP port 5554: Connection refused
root_cause: The sdkmanager command failed to download the Android SDK Build-Tools 36 package due to a network connection reset (likely a transient upstream outage or packet loss between the CI runner and Google's SDK server). As a result, the Android emulator was never installed or started, and ADB could not connect on port 5554. The CPU unit tests never ran.
reproduction_steps: N/A - transient network failure during CI dependency installation
recommended_actions: Re-run the failed jobs or re-add the PR to the merge queue to retry the transient network failure
If the failure recurs, check Google Android SDK server availability and network connectivity from CI runners
prevention_strategies: Add retry logic around sdkmanager install steps (--retry or a shell retry wrapper). Consider caching the Android SDK packages to reduce dependency on remote network availability.
